About Me

Hi, I'm Muhammad Maaz

I'm an SEO specialist and website developer based in Lahore, Pakistan, currently training in SEO at Monitex, Lahore. I moved to Lahore to learn SEO properly — and instead of only studying theory, I build and rank real websites.

I work on real projects — WordPress website design and development (Elementor, WooCommerce, custom themes, redesigns and speed optimisation) alongside SEO work like content audits, keyword research, on-page optimisation, internal linking and Search Console data — and I believe in honest numbers and steady, practical work.

WEBFLOW PROJECT

Bambu Training — Webflow Website Design & Development

Full Stack Developer, Web Designer

Webflow website design and development for Bambu Training — a business website for the official training program of Bambu Fitness Bali, built around the headline “It's time to get fit with Bambu Training.” The site presents the online training program members can use at the gym, at home, outside or while travelling.

The build covers the full Webflow setup — website and design setup, CMS setup and features setup — with a fully responsive design. The homepage brings together 100% customised daily workouts matched to each member's fitness level and goals, a 7-day free trial offer, video and testimonial sections, membership pricing and an FAQ section.

What was done

  • Website set up in Webflow, with the full design built in Webflow
  • CMS setup for the site's content
  • Features setup — programs, pricing, video, testimonials and FAQ

  • 6 training programs under 1 membership — Lift, Build, Booty, Hyrox, Shred and Perform
  • Membership pricing sections — Monthly $35 and Annual $210 (Save 50%) with a 7-day free trial
